description: Enhanced library-version attribute coverage on batch operations: every producer span of a multi-topic batch carries the configured version attribute, and every consumer span of a per-batch delivery (the receiving span and each processing span) carries it as well.

  messaging.destination=topic-a
  messaging.destination_kind=topic
  module.version=<version>
